messages.content: My best friend turns 30 next month and I want to organise a surprise dinner with our old university friends.
Nice idea. Pick a date with her partner so she's free, create a group chat without her, and choose a restaurant that takes larger bookings.
Most of the group lives in other cities. How do I make it easy for them to come?
Announce it at least four weeks ahead, pick a Saturday, suggest a hotel near the restaurant, and ask everyone to record a short message in case they can't make it.
Great, I'll message her partner tonight and set up the group chat this weekend.
